import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'examples/federated-work')
import funded_wire
manifest=pathlib.Path('examples/federated-work/fixtures/registered-work/manifest.json')
cases=json.loads(manifest.read_text())['cases']; shapes=funded_wire.Shapes(); results=[]
for case in cases:
 path=manifest.parent/case['file']; raw=path.read_bytes()
 rust=subprocess.run(['target/debug/chio-federated-work','experimental-funded-wire-check',str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 try:
  python=funded_wire.parse(raw,shapes); accepted=True
 except (ValueError,UnicodeError,OverflowError,RecursionError):
  python=None; accepted=False
 assert accepted==case['accepted']==(rust.returncode==0),case['name']
 if accepted: assert python==json.loads(rust.stdout),case['name']
 results.append(dict(name=case['name'],accepted=accepted,sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(results),passed=True,authorityVerified=False,results=results),indent=2))
